blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Mandaluyong City government on Wednesday stood by its purchase of 27 hybrid sport utility vehicles (SUVs), saying they would be used strictly for community operations. The local government said the vehicles, worth around P1 million each, distributed to barangay chairs would be used for security patrols, emergency response, and other essential services. Its statement came after photos of the turnover ceremony went viral and drew flak online.
